To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

1) concept-based translation models trained on clickthrough user data can improve the performance of query expansion; 2) the performance of concept-based models depends on the way the concepts are defined; 3) the best results are obtained with a model that uses the concept of phrase and the concept of proximity.
